title: Malicious code in hxqrtv-bznwkp-util (npm)
description: The npm package hxqrtv-bznwkp-util contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
